description: This file is a shell script used to test the behavior of Git repository selection and management in various scenarios, including handling directory structures and naming conventions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes temporary directories used for testing.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository and makes an initial commit.

methods.name: make_bare
methods.description: Creates a bare Git repository with a single commit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Clones a repository, fetching the content.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that the fetched and cloned repositories contain the expected commit message.
